signal_description: Double-A Birmingham shortstop Caleb Bonemer produced a .381/.519/.810 line for Aug. 10-16 with eight hits, a home run, two triples, two doubles, three walks and two steals, earning another organizational Player of the Week nod during a breakout 20-year-old season.
headline: Caleb Bonemer's repeated Double-A impact creates a pre-call-up hobby acceleration watch
why_now: Bonemer is already one of the White Sox system's premier prospects, reached Double-A in June and continues to stack impact weeks while staying years young for the level. Repeated weekly dominance plus proximity to Triple-A creates an attention-velocity signal before a major promotion or MLB roster catalyst.
thesis: Caleb Bonemer is an ACCELERATION-stage EDGE candidate: a highly regarded young shortstop is repeatedly outperforming Double-A competition before a call-up catalyst. His 2024 Bowman Draft Chrome Prospect Autograph CPA-CBO is the cleanest early hobby expression, but no capital action is permitted until authoritative Product Research comps establish whether the recent performance has already been priced in.
falsification: Bonemer's Double-A production materially regresses and the recent impact stretch proves transient.
Authoritative sold comps show the Bowman Draft Chrome autograph already repriced beyond an attractive entry.
The White Sox keep Bonemer outside a credible Triple-A/MLB progression window despite sustained production.

cards.label: 2024 Bowman Draft Chrome Prospect Autograph CPA-CBO Caleb Bonemer
cards.rationale: Verified Bowman Draft Chrome prospect autograph and the cleanest early autograph expression for a pre-call-up Bonemer thesis.
